_comment: Changing this file runs the 'Staging data load' workflow, which downloads, parses, checks and loads these datasets into STAGING (never production). cutoffs.cleanupYears first deletes those years' cutoff rows and every row stored under a non-normalised college code; cutoffs.years are then fully reloaded, oldest first (the latest year last, so its college and branch names win). Loads are idempotent. seatMatrix.years: parse and load the CAP seat matrix per year (replaces that year's rows). fees: true loads the fee table from fees.json (FRA) plus packages/pipeline/data/fees-manual.csv when present. placement: true loads the placement table from data/college-placement.json (NIRF, built by npm run placement).
